subject: Brand experience support — Lumen Collective renewal & 2026 launch
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily@lumencollective.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal — Brand experience & launch production support 2026

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. As discussed, attached is our proposal for ongoing brand experience support through the Q3 product launch window. High level: production for the keynote town hall, two regional meetups (SF, NYC), press outreach for launch announcements, and design/creative support for the microsite + assets.

Summary highlights:
- Retainer model (monthly) + event production pass-throughs (venues, AV)
- Estimated monthly retainer: $40k–$55k depending on scope (see pricing table)
- Proposed kickoff: 6/15; full ramp by 7/1

Documents attached: Lumen_Proposal_Q3-2026.pdf (proposal + line-item pricing).

We can tighten the scope to hit a $40k monthly cap if you want to prioritize media/launch vs. experiential extras. If helpful, I can send a pared-down options sheet by Friday. Please let me know key constraints (budget, payment terms) and we’ll adjust.

Would love a quick 30m call next week to walk the proposal with your team.

Best,
Emily Stone
Director, Client Strategy
Lumen Collective
(emily@lumencollective.com)

--
Attachment: Lumen_Proposal_Q3-2026.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal — Brand experience & launch production support 2026

Folks — forwarding Emily’s proposal for the brand/launch work. Key asks: do we want the full retainer or a trimmed-down launch-only package? Budget note: we currently have ~ $180k allocated for marketing events/launch support in Q3 (commit not fully locked). Marcus, can you confirm whether we can flex to $220k if execs push for experiential elements?

Quick thoughts:
- Laura: prioritize PR + keynote production; we can probably defer the regional meetups to a later phase if budget is tight.
- Evelyn: need your read on channel tie-ins and whether we can consolidate creative work to the design team instead of external to save cost.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal decision on target monthly spend (this week)
2) Ask Lumen for a trimmed option and 45-day net payment terms
3) Procurement to draft renewal/PO once scope agreed

Quoted below from Emily’s note for context.

From: Emily Stone <emily@lumencollective.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — Brand experience & launch production support 2026

Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick read-through and the call on Friday. Per our conversation I’m attaching a trimmed option that removes the second regional meetup and reduces retained creative hours — that brings the retainer to $38k/month with an itemized list for any add-on activations. I also updated payment terms to Net 45 for engagements > 6 months.

Changes included in Lumen_SOW_v2.docx (attached):
- Remove NYC meetup (option to add back as a single-day pop-up)
- Reduce design retainer hours to 40/month (from 80)
- Add press outreach milestone tied to launch announcement (deliverable 7/8)

If you confirm scope by Friday (5/28) we can secure preferred vendor rates for venues and lock the 7/1 production timeline.

Best,
Emily

--
Attachment: Lumen_SOW_v2.docx (DOCX, revision 2)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — Brand experience & launch production support 2026

Vanessa — ran the numbers on the trimmed option. If we accept Lumen’s trimmed SOW (38k/mo + pass-throughs), projected Q3 spend sits around $160k–$175k depending on venue/AV. That fits inside our current marketing events allocation but leaves minimal buffer for contingency or extra PR spend.

Neha — what’s the preferred procurement route here? PO or short-term contract amendment to the existing retainer? Also, Emily proposed Net 45. Finance will usually accept Net 30; can we push Net 45 if Lumen will take a modest discount in return?

I recommend: approve trimmed SOW, ask for a 7–10% discount in exchange for a 12-month retainer commitment (if Lumen will agree), and push payment terms to Net 45. If we can’t land Net 45, accept Net 30 and request an early-pay 2% discount.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Finance Business Partner, Marketing
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Approval to proceed — trimmed launch package (Net 45 request)

Emily — thank you and the Lumen team for the revised SOW. We’re prepared to move forward with the trimmed launch package (remove the second regional meetup; retain keynote production + PR + reduced creative hours) on the terms below:

- Monthly retainer: $38,000
- Pass-throughs for venue/AV reimbursed at cost with pre-approval
- Term: initial 6 months with option to extend to 12 months
- Payment terms: request Net 45. Marcus will confirm finance approval, Neha will run contract routing.
- Request: 7% discount if we sign a 12-month commitment by 6/10; otherwise proceed with 6-month SOW at $38k.

Neha/Marcus — please follow up with contract draft and PO. Emily, please send the final contract draft and an invoice template (we’ll need it to set up the vendor).

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Brand Programs
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
